caption: The drawing depicts a single slipper or shoe positioned horizontally and viewed from the side. The shoe has a beige or light tan base color with detailed needlepoint embroidery covering most of its surface. The embroidered patterns are composed of geometric and floral motifs in several colors, including blue, green, pink, brown, and purple. The embroidery wrapped around the upper part of the shoe, from the toe to the heel, showcases varied shapes and color patches. The interior lining of the shoe is depicted with shaded coloring to indicate depth, using lighter beige tones. The background is a plain, slightly off-white surface with a few faint yellowish-brown stains or marks scattered around the shoe, without any additional objects or decorations. The edges of the shoe are carefully outlined, and the composition centers the shoe horizontally within the image.
title: Woman's Slipper
